encounters.name: RAZORWAKE
encounters.title: The Slipstream Hunter
encounters.pitch: A compact wind interceptor that hunts you through the clouds. A faster, more physical contrast to the Siege Fortress.
encounters.palette: White, steel gray, deep teal and royal-blue cockpit glass.
encounters.slot: Furious-only alternative to the Stage 6 miniboss. Keep the fight solo. Do not add it alongside the Fortress or alter the later Harrier / Rough Riders choice.
encounters.anatomy: Two actual wing-root rotary cannons protect the fuselage. Proposed budget: 30% per cannon, 40% exposed body. Shots must pass through the protected body to reach either cannon. Engines and intake fans remain passive.

attacks.name: Airbrake Ambush
attacks.tell: Wing brakes spread, teal source-pixel charge and two clear gun lanes.
attacks.action: It surges north, brakes into view and fires two committed rotary-cannon streams from the actual pods.
attacks.counter: Move between or outside the lanes after aim commits. The barrels cannot track you during that burst.

attacks.name: Knife-Edge Pass
attacks.tell: Metal side warning and a committed crossing lane.
attacks.action: It rolls into profile and crosses the screen with a visible floor/cloud shadow and a short, finite wind wake.
attacks.counter: Change vertical position, roll or somersault. The exhaust is visual propulsion, not a separate weapon.

attacks.name: Shear Volley
attacks.tell: Teal emission from the dedicated wing-edge ports, matching spread FOV.
attacks.action: It launches narrow, elongated wind blades in staggered rows, then exposes itself during the drift turn.
attacks.counter: Read the gaps and punish the turning recovery. Wind blades are ordinary energy and cannot be shot down.

encounters.break: Breaking a cannon removes that stream, its target and its warnings. When both break, the body opens and it relies on warned passes and short wind volleys.
encounters.art: Whole craft idle, airbrake, gun recoil, 8/16 headings, true roll/somersault/drift, two real turret modules, thruster levels, wind-blade travel/impact, depth shadows and native-style breakup.
encounters.warning: The board illustrates the design and motion. Its bullet angles are not a tested firing solution; production must use the real pod sockets and verified escape space.

encounters.name: THUNDERHEAD
encounters.title: Storm Containment Dreadnought
encounters.pitch: An industrial machine carrying a captive storm. Its pressure projectors divide the arena into readable routes while the reactor changes the shape of the fight.
encounters.palette: Weathered white/steel armor, dark teal machinery, cyan-white storm energy and restrained hazard yellow.
encounters.slot: A separately chosen Furious storm contact. It should replace that run's main boss route, not force the player through Harrier, Nightwing, Rough Riders and another boss in one stage. Story/reward mapping needs approval before implementation.
encounters.anatomy: Four visible gun turrets and two side pressure-projector modules protect the central reactor. All six must go before reactor exposure. The separate rear propulsion units are passive. Breaking a weapon cancels its queued attacks; no invisible emitter remains.

attacks.name: Pressure Gates
attacks.tell: The two pressure towers open mechanically and charge in alternating order.
attacks.action: Two descending wind sheets create a broad channel, then shift their opening for the next committed release.
attacks.counter: Enter the announced channel. It must remain reachable at the player's current speed and cannot close around an aircraft.

attacks.name: Storm Rail
attacks.tell: A bright reactor pulse and a filled, three-color warning showing the entire path.
attacks.action: A horizontal electric front descends with one deliberately open section; the turrets remain quiet during this heavy turn.
attacks.counter: Move into the opening before release. No mandatory last-frame dodge or projectile interception.

attacks.name: Eye of the Storm
attacks.tell: Broken outer guns go quiet; reactor shutters open with a rising charge.
attacks.action: Curving electric streams frame a moving clear eye while the exposed reactor becomes the damage objective.
attacks.counter: Follow the opening, then punish the long venting recovery. Do not overlap the pressure gates with this pattern.

encounters.break: Each gun removed visibly simplifies the gun pressure. Reactor exposure is an earned phase, not an extra hidden health refill.
encounters.art: A full identity/turn set, mechanical shutter animation, separate real turrets, pressure-projector charging, continuous electric fronts, reactor flow/pulse, damage/hit states and a full-size destruction sequence.
encounters.warning: The concept's pressure-tower mouths are weapon projectors, not the existing Fortress's passive fans. Existing Harrier/Fortress fan rules stay unchanged. The illustrated orb density is not a balance target.

encounters.name: SUMPJAW
encounters.title: The Reclamation Beast
encounters.pitch: A toxic industrial lamprey with a mechanical intake mouth and living cable spine. A physical sewer predator instead of another tank or spider.
encounters.palette: Olive/charcoal armor, chromium teeth, black tendons and toxic lime with pale yellow-hot cores.
encounters.slot: Furious-only alternative to the Caustic Dredger. Keep the existing sewer entrance, clear floor and Warden encounter. Do not restore the removed pipe hazards.
encounters.anatomy: Two visible toxic gill sacs are the early objectives; rupturing both exposes the intake heart. The whole creature uses authored poses, not runtime stretching of a flat plate. A proposed 25% / 25% / 50% budget avoids extra health phases.

attacks.name: Corkscrew Breach
attacks.tell: A short moving ground Retina acquires, then locks; bubbles and a metal warning identify the surfacing point.
attacks.action: It rises from the floor into the foreground with a true depth/rotation bank and attempts a committed bite.
attacks.counter: Leave the locked mark and attack the gills during its landing recovery. It cannot be damaged or bite you while still distant.

attacks.name: Coughing Fit
attacks.tell: The real mouth tilts up, fills and flashes toxic green; separate landing marks appear as each globule launches.
attacks.action: Three large arcing toxic globules land at separated points, burst once and send finite droplets outward.
attacks.counter: Read the landing marks and dodge the scatter. Neither globules nor fragments bounce indefinitely.

attacks.name: Drain and Strike
attacks.tell: It braces, the mouth opens and one bite corridor commits.
attacks.action: A brief suction-looking charge precedes a powerful straight lunge. It then visibly backs off to expose its gills.
attacks.counter: Step off the corridor and punish recovery. No hidden pull on the player's controls; no invisible body hit outside the actual foreground creature.

encounters.break: Broken sacs stop their discharge and reveal the central heart. Its desperate phase keeps breach and bite pressure, with fewer shots and clearer attack recovery rather than a health refill.
encounters.art: Complete coil/straighten/turn/depth poses, jaw opening and tooth motion, intact/ruptured sacs, mouth charge, toxic lob/rain/splash, shadows, real white hits and whole-body destruction.
encounters.warning: This is a concept identity and action board. The splashes and tail poses still need production frame normalization and collision work after selection.

dracodia.name: DRONE / FIRST HOST
dracodia.current: Already has physical swipes/capture, inset-tube missiles, optic fans/sweeps and the protected arm/core budget.

hard.name: Cross Examination
hard.pitch: A deliberate optic sweep followed by one physical counter-swipe, presented as two readable commitments.
steps: Eye looks and charges toward the committed sweep direction.
A red optic fan clears one side; chest tubes stay quiet.
The beam ends, the surviving claw gives a separate warning, then rakes the return route.
A visible retraction opens the arm-damage window.
hard.counter: Change lanes for the beam, then move again for the separately warned claw. Destroying that claw cancels the follow-up.
hard.assets: Linked pupil-look / arm-brace / extend / retract poses. Reuse the approved red optics and current claw identity.

furious.name: Blindside Verdict
furious.pitch: The eye and one claw attack opposite routes in sequence, making you read two decisions rather than dodge a denser wall.
steps: Eye and the selected shoulder both light up; the first optic route is fixed.
The eye fires; the claw is held back.
After the beam clears, a second warning commits the claw across the opposite lane.
The other side remains open and the body recovers before missiles resume.
furious.counter: Do not stay in the first escape lane forever. The second warning must allow a real return path; never fire beam and trapping claw together.
furious.assets: Two linked left/right variants and stronger source-pixel tells. Preserve 33.3% / 33.3% / 33.4% and the armless core phase.

dracodia.name: FINAL MAIN BODY
dracodia.current: Already has the new articulated side rakes, tucked jump/double strike and chest-origin Luminaire. Those are the baseline, not new proposals.

hard.name: Scissor Descent
hard.pitch: A diagonal version of the background jump, retaining the two Nick-inspired physical claw strikes.
steps: The background retreat turns visibly toward one upper corner.
One diagonal route and landing Retina commit.
He crosses diagonally into the foreground, lands and delivers the existing two alternating strikes.
He retracts and returns to the normal recovery.
hard.counter: Read the entry direction instead of expecting a vertical drop. Keep the existing full ground warning and real blade contact.
hard.assets: True diagonal approach/turn poses and exact moving claw sockets. Keep the current armor, blades and two-strike identity.

furious.name: Crownfall Triad
furious.pitch: One special book entry with three marked leaps and the double claw strike at the final landing.
steps: A crown-like chest charge identifies the special entry.
Three landing points are shown in order; each commits before that leap.
He jumps through the three locations, finishing with the two physical claw strikes.
An enlarged punish window follows; Luminaire waits until this sequence is over.
furious.counter: Move through the ordered gaps, then attack recovery. This replaces an ordinary combo occasionally; it is not appended to every combo.
furious.assets: Three continuous jump routes, turn/landing links and a distinct charge tell. No extra life bars, hidden landing blasts or simultaneous Luminaire.

dracodia.name: CORRUPTED CHRONOS
dracodia.current: Already has the canonical single hammer, 1/2/4 difficulty strikes, real throw/recall, dark chromium, chaingun handoff and crimson code rage/wave.

hard.name: Comet Guard
hard.pitch: A clearly separated unarmed shoulder rush while the real hammer is in its existing orbit.
steps: He releases the one canonical hammer on a visible committed orbit.
His empty hands brace and a single shoulder-charge lane warns.
He makes one foreground rush while the hammer continues its actual path.
He recalls and catches it before resuming the hammer book.
hard.counter: Dodge the rush or use a missile to reverse the hammer's direction. A missile does not force an early recall.
hard.assets: Unarmed brace/rush/recovery and linked catch poses. Reuse the exact current hammer bitmap, chromium and rage styling.

furious.name: Comet Recall
furious.pitch: Two alternating unarmed charges, then a fully signalled catch and recovery.
steps: The one real hammer leaves his hands and starts its finite orbit.
One charge lane commits, fires and clears.
A second opposite charge gets its own warning before he moves.
He becomes still enough to read the recall/catch, then exposes a damage window.
furious.counter: Read one rush at a time. Do not overlap this with the rage wave or a chaingun fan; only missiles may reverse the hammer.
furious.assets: Mirrored body twists, empty-hand sockets and a clear catch tell. No duplicate hammers or round shield.

dracodia.name: CORRUPTED HELICOPTER
dracodia.current: Already has smaller body scale, fast rotor frames, aimed destructible pods, shootable locked missiles, straight gun lanes and red sonic fronts.

hard.name: Rotor Gate
hard.pitch: Two partial red pressure arcs form a large announced escape opening.
steps: The helicopter banks and both live pressure emitters charge.
A partial-arc warning shows the opening before release.
Two red fronts descend with the same clear opening.
The body banks back and exposes its pods.
hard.counter: Enter the opening, then punish the bank. Sonic fronts remain unshootable; this is not another missile pattern.
hard.assets: New partial-arc pressure frames and bank links. Keep real rotor/pod anchors and the digital jungle.

furious.name: Scissor Rotor
furious.pitch: A three-quarter pressure formation leaves a visibly travelling open quadrant.
steps: The open quadrant is shown by the full warning before anything becomes harmful.
A partial ring of red pressure advances while its opening moves at a tested reachable pace.
The last front clears before any locked missile volley begins.
A longer hover recovery opens a retaliation window.
furious.counter: Follow the opening rather than cross a closed front. Never close the route with simultaneous homing missiles.
furious.assets: Authored directional arc/front banks, warning phases and a complete entry/release/exit. No renderer-rotated ring.

dracodia.name: NEURAL ARCHON
dracodia.current: Already has pupil-filled warm optic beams, actual source-pose eye anchors, night clouds, unboxed geysers and a finite cloud shield.

hard.name: Blinkfire
hard.pitch: The left and right eyes fire as two distinct commitments, creating a readable step-through rhythm.
steps: One pupil looks and charges; the other remains visibly dormant.
That eye fires its full-aperture beam, then stops.
The second eye gives a fresh directional tell and fires.
Both lenses cool before geysers or cloud shielding resume.
hard.counter: Move after each eye commits. The beam must still grow from the actual pupil and match its warm eye color.
hard.assets: Left/right focus, blink and recovery poses with exact eye sockets. Reuse the approved warm red/orange/ivory optics.

furious.name: Synaptic Guillotine
furious.pitch: Opposing diagonal eye sweeps form a moving V corridor with a deliberately open escape flank.
steps: Both eyes charge and a full warning shows the two paths and the opening.
The first beam sweeps, then the second begins on a tested delay.
Their active spans never seal the player's reachable exit.
The beams dissipate and the brain remains exposed before other attacks return.
furious.counter: Follow the open flank. No geyser may be cast into that escape corridor during this entry.
furious.assets: Diagonal eye poses/continuous directional optics and matched warning/damage spans. No boxes, extra scenery or permanent cloud immunity.

dracodia.name: PHOENIX / VOLCANO
dracodia.current: Already has true twin turbo fire, one chest-core beam, four shuffled corner rushes and 8â€“12 Order of the Phoenix copies.

hard.name: Ashen Relay
hard.pitch: Keep the same fire-copy count but send it through a clear left / center / right lane sequence.
steps: The current fire-wind charge and wing acceleration identify Order of the Phoenix.
Copies commit through three visible lanes in a readable repeating sequence.
Each dangerous body leaves before the next route closes.
The current charge-down and long foreground recovery remain.
hard.counter: Read the lane order instead of relying on one edge forever. Preserve the current 8â€“12 cap and actual foreground-only danger.
hard.assets: Use the current exact Phoenix outline and fire fill. Additional approach headings only if needed; no new identity.

furious.name: Forked Order
furious.pitch: Paired fire outlines alternate between flanking routes and the middle, without increasing the total number of copies.
steps: The established charge identifies the cast; the first pair's opening is shown.
A flanking pair leaves the middle open.
A central pair opens the flanks; fewer firing moments compensate for each pair.
All copies clear before his return and punish window.
furious.counter: Switch between middle and side routes on the visible cadence. Validate every transition using actual travel speed, not just a geometric gap.
furious.assets: Paired committed routes, corresponding directional bodies and exact per-copy ground marks. Do not add extra copies, duplicate life bars or turbo cannons during the cast.
